about.title: Daly City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Daly City recorded one traffic death in 2025, alongside 257 injury collisions that hurt 336 people. On a San Mateo County report it is a single figure; for one family somewhere near Mission Street or John Daly Boulevard, it reshaped everything. Wrongful death claims here are not limited to traffic, either. A fall at a job site, a medical error, a defective product, or an act of violence can each leave a household without someone it counted on. California gives the first right to sue to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, with certain dependents and heirs able to step in if there are none. The clock generally runs two years from the date of death, and it is far shorter when a public agency such as the city, the county, or Caltrans (which oversees I-280 and Junipero Serra Boulevard) may share responsibility. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Daly City families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency, so you can ask questions before deciding anything.

whyChoose.title: Why Daly City Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines Handled Early
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is much shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting connected promptly protects those dates.

items.title: All Losses Accounted For
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your family member would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney works on contingency to pursue each of these.

items.question: Our family member died in a crash on I-280 through Daly City. Does that change anything about the claim?
items.answer: It might. I-280 is a state highway, so if a road condition or design contributed, a claim against Caltrans could be part of the case, and claims against government entities carry a much shorter filing window than the usual two years. Even if another driver was entirely at fault, an attorney will want to review the collision report early. The sooner the facts are gathered, the more options your family keeps.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution in San Mateo County. The criminal case is about punishment; the civil case is about compensating your family for what was taken. Your two-year deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court.

items.question: Is there any cost to use LawProactive or to speak with the attorney?
items.answer: There is no charge to use LawProactive, and we are not a law firm. We simply connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims in Daly City. That attorney works on contingency, meaning no fee is owed unless there is a recovery.
